title: SquigDecode Input Parameters Schema
description: Validation schema for Nanopore signal simulation and model training parameters.

num_sequences.description: Total number of synthetic DNA reads to generate.

noise_std_max.description: Maximum Gaussian noise (pA) to simulate high-interference runs.

use_noise_curriculum.description: If true, training starts with clean signals and gradually introduces noise.

train_learning_rate.description: Initial learning rate for the Adam optimizer.
